releaseNotes:
- Version 2.1.0
- The Rayence test waits for the shot to end before it checks the statuses
- The ruler in an export reads like the ruler in the app
- A Rayence picture lies the way Logos shows it
- The Rayence panel waits for the image and every shot gets its own session
- One session for the Rayence panel
- The card keeps its width without the Stop button
- Stop is hidden where it cannot stop
- The panel error goes back to the log
- The log goes back to Information
- The panel status keeps checking, and an error is shown
